profile.headline: Systems Software Engineer, GPU Server at NVIDIA
profile.jobTitle: Principal Systems Software Engineer, GPU Server
profile.summary: Software architect and engineering expert with 25 years of experience. 14 years of experience leading small teams for tools and product development. Experienced in agile project planning, test driven development, leadership, mentorship, OO architecture and development in C/C++/C#, Python (include ONNX, Pytorch, Pandas/Numpy) and Perl utilizing various REST and programming APIs (e.g. DirectX) at the application and hardware interface level.

positions.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer, GPU Server
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Focused on Validation of GPU Server configurations.

positions.title: Sr Staff Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading and mentoring a team focused on user-mode graphics driver memory management. Focusing on performance analysis and optimizations related to memory footprint and efficiency. Also, rearchitecting and improving the current memory manager code quality. Focused on efficiency and platform portability in Windows and Linux for eventual Open Sourcing.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Problem Solving and +8 skills

positions.title: Sr Staff Graphics Software Enginner
positions.description: Graphics co-development engineer engaging with Microsoft, to develop new graphics centered features in the graphics drivers. Negotiated the design and implementation of new OS features, including the addition of MetaCommands to the DirectML API.  Also, implemented several WinML/DirectML based tools and test applications for demonstration purposes.  Implemented IRQ based notification system for Super Wet Ink.  WinMR PoC and Bringup on Intel's Kabylake integrated graphics.
positions.insights: Problem Solving, Object Oriented Design and +9 skills

positions.title: Lead Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led a team of 5-8 software engineers of all levels as SCRUM Master and Product Owner focused on Intel’s graphics performance simulator over-all software architecture, building blocks, and infrastructure.  Managed tasks and quarterly plans for the team, to achieve on time delivery of the simulator for key HW architects, and Power and Performance projection teams.

Designed and implemented the continuous integration system for simulation CI, utilizing customized python scripting, Gerrit for code review and TeamCity’s build infrastructure.  CI server is designed to execute unit testing on both Linux and Windows, integration with several internal libraries, external libraries (systemc and boost), validation and auto notification of customer specific required files, and executes extremely long test cycles (3D frames - several days); along with pre-validation of changes before they are pushed to the master branch.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Problem Solving and +13 skills

patents.title: Memory Micro-Tiling Request Reordering
patents.description: According to one embodiment, a memory controller is disclosed. The memory controller includes assignment logic, a reorder table and a transaction assembler. The assignment logic receives a request to access a memory channel and assigns the request to access one of two or more independently addressable subchannels within the channel. The reorder table includes two or more table elements. Each table element includes a shared address component and an independent address component corresponding to each of the two or more independently addressable subchannels. The transaction assembler combines the shared and independent address components in a reorder table element and issue a single memory transaction.

patents.title: Method and Apparatus for Producing Animation
patents.description: In some embodiments, a method includes generating blurred copies of an object by applying multi-texturing to the object during one pass through a graphics processing pipeline. In some embodiments, a graphics pipeline includes a texture memory and a graphics processor coupled to the texture memory. The texture memory provides a location to store texture information. The graphics processor provides processor to process the texture information by shifting and blending the texture information in one pass through the graphics processor to obtain shifted and blended texture information.
